rationale: The DEV-01..11 / AI-01..11 policy is now wired into the existing Agent Workload execution-plan compiler as a fail-closed preflight. This changes task-local admission semantics but does not create or promote a provider, runner, daemon, scheduler, hardware path, host lease, driver, service, credential flow, or physical Current Host PASS. Agent Workload Current Host status remains PENDING_CURRENT_HOST, so there is no previously admitted physical PASS to inherit or requalify. UAF, Security Governance, HRB, Model Router and Evidence retain their existing authorities.
